title: Media Franchise Revenues
hook: This data comes from Wikipedia and includes franchises that have grossed at least $4 billion usd. How do different media franchises stack up with their revenue streams? I took a stab at cleaning up the data in R directly from the source - I made some opinionated decisions about how to group categories (there were > 60 distinct categories), if you'd like a deeper dive on data cleaning try working with the data purely from the source. I have included my script in this repo so you can take a peek at how we got here. A popular reddit/dataisbeautiful post examined this data with ggplot2. mediafranchises <- readr::readcsv("
